Yogesh Singh Reappointed Delhi University Vice-Chancellor for Second Term

Professor Yogesh Singh has been reappointed as the Vice-Chancellor of Delhi University for a second consecutive term. He initially assumed office on October 8, 2021. This reappointment marks him as the first Delhi University VC to receive such a consecutive second term.
